messages:
tara: sharing the near-final launch post draft + localized snippets for EU/JP. doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/4-launch-localize. quick passes: legal, ops, translations pls.
kevin: quick read looks good. one note: hero currently says 'up to 2.8x lower median latency' 94 we need the exact bench command for legal. also ask translations to review the CTA tone for JP.
sam: legal here. add bench harness + date and a short disclaimer 'internal benchmark, your mileage may vary'. avoid 'industry-leading' phrasing.
tara: added bench under appendix:
```
./microbench --model rwd-medium-q4 --baseline open-small --seq 128 --batch 6 --hw g5 --runs 120 --seed 11
```
results: median 48ms vs 133ms (2.77x). run date 2026-03-28.
lia: translations note: JP team recommends softer CTA. suggested JP copy: 'デモに参加して、実際のレイテンシとコスト削減をご覧ください' instead of direct 'Register now'. will paste localized CTA in doc.
kevin: routing: include hidden fields `product_interest=redwood_inference` and `launch_segment=local_preview`. UTM string please.
tara: primary CTA UTM:
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=jun_launch&utm_content=localized_cta&launch_segment=local_preview
```
sam: ops: route leads from EU to sales queue `eu-launch`, JP to `apac-launch`, NA default `na-launch`. For first 72h, priority routing to `launch-priority`. Also mark contacts with `content_variant=localized` when they come from localized CTAs.
publish-bot: scheduling request received. requested publish: 2026-06-02T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). embargo enabled, will notify #press and #social on release.
tara: legal quick-pass 2705 with bench footnote. translations ok. locking copy EOD today and will push images. thanks everyone!
